title: Files
description: How uploads end, which a client that sends files the API doesn't accept or that hold malware, a scanner or a bucket that stops answering, changes, whether the scanner and the bucket answer the API's calls, and how old the scanner's signatures are (the files spec).

panels.title: How do uploads end?
panels.description: Uploads in the last 5 minutes that reached the check of their bytes, by how each ended: stored, unsupported_type, its bytes of no kind the API accepts, malware_detected, when the scanner refused them, or failed, as when the scanner or the bucket doesn't answer, or the route's timeout ends the upload (FILES-013). A rise in failed beside 503s on the upload route is the scanner's or the bucket's, which the panels beside tell apart.

panels.title: Does the bucket answer?
panels.description: Calls to the bucket of files' bytes in the last 5 minutes, writes, reads, deletions and listings, by how each ended: ok, not_found, failed, when the bucket refused the call or answered what the client couldn't read, or unavailable, when it didn't answer in time or answered that it can't serve now (FILES-012). Only unavailable calls, with no answered one, are the alert StorageUnreachable.

panels.title: Does the scanner answer?
panels.description: Scans by the malware scanner in the last 5 minutes, by how each ended: clean, found, when it named a signature, failed, when it answered with an error or with what the client couldn't read, or unavailable, when it couldn't be reached, closed the connection, or didn't answer within 30 seconds (PLATFORM-079); a scan that its request's timeout drops first counts in none. Only unavailable scans, with no answered one, are the alert ScannerUnreachable.

panels.title: How old are the scanner's signatures?
panels.description: How long ago freshclam last wrote the scanner's daily signatures, which ClamAV publishes several times a day. Over 2 days is the alert ScannerSignaturesOutdated. Empty in development and the tests, which scan with one signature of the repository's own.
